children: BERLIN, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GlocalMe, a leading global mobile connectivity brand under the Nasdaq-listed technology solution provider uCloudlink Group Inc. (

), showcases its latest lineup of consumer-grade internet solutions at IFA 2026, Europe's largest technology trade show. The brand brings a range of lifestyle gadgets for travelers seeking uninterrupted internet access to support their business and emergency needs.

GlocalMe believes connectivity is the foundation on which AI is built. As the AI wave reshapes how people work and travel, it is connectivity and data flow that will determine how far, how fast, and how intelligently this new era can move.
MeowGo Hotspots: Reliable Communications Even in Remote Areas

At the center of GlocalMe's IFA portfolio is the MeowGo G50 Max, an advanced 5G satellite mobile Wi-Fi hotspot that unifies 5G cellular speed, satellite resilience, and intelligent Wi-Fi management in a single device. Equipped with a Qualcomm QCM4490 chip, it is the first product on the market to pair an AI assistant with a 5G hotspot that keeps working even when base station infrastructure is down — as much an emergency lifeline as a travel companion.

Designed for a broad range of real-world scenarios, the G50 Max doubles as a backup communication tool when it is needed most: through its partnership with Skylo's satellite network, it lets users send SMS messages in 38 destinations even when regular signals go dark during natural disasters or power outages. Unlike other mobile Wi-Fi hotspots on the market, it's also a fully-fledged AI travel assistant, handling translation, exchange-rate conversion, route planning, and more to smooth the whole trip. Backed by uCloudlink's underlying technology and partnerships with 390+ carriers worldwide, the device connects users to internet service in over 200 countries and regions.
Pack Less, Experience More On The Go

Beyond Wi-Fi hotspots, GlocalMe offers a range of multi-in-one lifestyle devices that handle charging, connectivity, and locating all at once—freeing up space in a traveler's backpack. The Life Series and other offerings include the RoamPlug universal travel adapter, the UniCord family of charging cables, the eSIM Trio which brings eSIM connectivity to legacy phones, and a lineup of Wi-Fi hotspot + power bank combos. Each is built around the same principle: global connectivity should live inside the everyday tools travelers already carry, not add another item to pack.
These devices draw on CloudSIM technology to tap directly into the strongest available local signal, and are all managed through a single GlocalMe app.

Powered by the patented HyperConn™ and CloudSIM technologies, GlocalMe products let users connect to fast internet service worldwide without the need for costly roaming. The brand was born to solve pressing needs for frequent travelers and emergency responders who require continuous connectivity across a wide range of complex scenarios.

"As travel and remote work become borderless, we believe connectivity should be too. The world is going through a lot of unexpected events, which have pushed us to build solutions people can truly count on. Our IFA 2026 lineup is built to keep people online in the moments that matter most, wherever they are," said Jeff Chen, CEO and Founder of uCloudlink.
IFA attendees are welcome to visit the booth at
, Messe Berlin, to experience the latest launches in person.

GlocalMe is a mobile connectivity brand powered by uCloudlink Group Inc., an industry pioneer in mobile data traffic sharing marketplace and a pioneer of the sharing economy business model in the telecommunications industry.

uCloudlink was listed on the NASDAQ in 2020. The company has redefined the mobile data connectivity experience by enabling users to access data traffic shared by network operators, without requiring a physical SIM card.
